F00.text: Oh! Didn't hear you coming. Don't know your face, either… You've come up from the shore? You're soaked through.

F10.text: On the coast, just below the village. Follow this path uphill and you'll reach it. You look like you've had a rough landing.

choices.text: Where should I go in the village?

F11.text: Depends what you need. I can point you toward shelter. If it's trouble out at sea, these old legs won't be much use.

choices.text: My boat crashed on the rocks.

F20.text: Keep to the path until you reach the houses. Someone there can help you find a place to rest.

choices.text: What if they don't want a stranger there?

F21.text: Ordinary folk. People working, trading, getting on with their day. They'll notice a new face soon enough.

choices.text: Who should I speak to first?
Do you get many strangers here?

F22.text: Then head into the village. Get out of those wet clothes and ask for somewhere to sit by a fire. Sea wind cuts right through you.

choices.text: Can I rest here for a moment?

F23.text: The rocks below the path? Nasty stretch of coast. You're fortunate you made it ashore. Leave the wreck alone until you've got your strength back.

choices.text: Could you help me recover my things?
Is there anyone in the village who could help?

E01.text: No, I'll stay with my nets. You can see the roofs from here. Keep walking uphill.

E02.text: Tell them you washed ashore. Someone will hear you out.

E03.text: Start with someone by the houses. Ask where a traveler can rest, and take it from there.

E04.text: A few. Most arrive a good deal drier than you.

E05.text: Ask anyway. A place by the fire needn't cost a fortune.

E06.text: Catch your breath, then. But don't sit in the wind too long. The village is warmer.

E07.text: Can't do that for you. Ask in the village, and mind those rocks if you go back.

E08.text: Perhaps. Ask around the village. You'll have better luck there than with an old man and a torn net.
